body:
## Parent

https://github.com/EvgenyHitexis/EucWatch/issues/43

## What to build

Edit any of the four saved riding presets entirely locally through the laptop's 240×240 staging interface. All changes stay in one transient preset draft until whole-editor Save succeeds; Cancel discards them. Save/Cancel work directly from an open text or numeric keypad. Remove preset-clearing UI and obsolete per-field completion behavior.

Follow #43, the agreed glossary, ADR 0002 and the confirmed interaction specification. This replaces the fresh-wheel open gate, editor wheel writes and per-adjustment persistence from #41/#42. The separate navigation slice adds the revised swipe hierarchy and wrapping gestures; this slice must already provide a complete usable Save/Cancel journey through the existing field controls.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Settings → Presets → any fixed slot immediately opens its saved name, sensitivity, assist, remembered dip and inclusion, without scanning, connecting, reading the wheel or waiting for a frame. Editing works in idle, disconnected, simulator and replay contexts, respecting existing awake/recovery and controlling-browser rules. Wheel reconnects/session replacement and incoming settings cannot replace, terminate or reset the draft or active input.
- [ ] Name, whole-percentage input and dip inclusion affect only the draft. Toggling omission retains the remembered value, which remains editable while omitted. Moving between fields preserves all entered text, including incomplete numeric input. Other saved slots and alerts remain unchanged before Save.
- [ ] Save collects every field plus the active keypad's latest input, validates the whole preset, and commits exactly one selected-slot replacement through the existing durable store. Publish the new saved configuration/revision and return to preset selection only after success. Compose with the current other three slots and alert preferences; never restore an old whole-configuration snapshot.
- [ ] Cancel from any page or active keypad discards the complete draft, returns to preset selection, and leaves saved values and revision unchanged. Save and Cancel are the two editor completion actions. Remove Save slot, editor Back, preset Clear controls/dialogs in both editor and selection list, and separate Set/Done completion targets. Keep character clearing and backspace as input operations; preserve case, spaces, digits and name entry within 240×240.
- [ ] Enforce 1–24 readable name characters with non-whitespace content, valid whole percentages 0–100 for sensitivity, assist and remembered dip, and explicit inclusion even when dip is omitted. Empty/unfinished/invalid input stays editable across fields but cannot save. Identify the invalid field visibly within the watch-sized UI and retain all edits for correction.
- [ ] Failed/refused local Save preserves the previously committed configuration, retains the full draft/latest input, stays in the editor and shows a local retry reason. A retry commits the complete draft once and closes the editor. Retain previous-good recovery through interruption, including first-save and migrated configurations.
- [ ] Close the completed editor operation so duplicate/delayed Save cannot reapply its draft. Preserve browser ownership and stale-request guards. Replacing/reloading configuration invalidates an old editor operation and requires explicit fresh opening before it can overwrite newer content. Reload/restart restores only saved definitions, never the draft/page/keypad or pending commands.
- [ ] Opening, input, inclusion, field navigation, validation failure, Save/failure/retry and Cancel emit zero wheel-setting packets and create no editor command/confirmation state. Retire the old editor-specific writer path and reject stale per-field/Clear actions that could revive withdrawn operations. A local Save is never wheel confirmation. Revision changes still invalidate outstanding/currently confirmed riding-preset operations and stop unsent continuation.
- [ ] The separate riding preset menu immediately applies only successfully saved included values. An unsaved or failed draft cannot change what it applies. Keep existing serialized operation, eligibility, bounded outcomes and read-only replay.

## Tests and evidence

- Reuse public application action/raw-notification/observable-view/command-output tests, HTTP ownership/deduplication tests and actual built Canvas/backend flows. Use real application/parser/store/transport code; only external clock/file/BLE/browser inputs are controlled. No new private-module seam.
- Exercise all four slots offline using on-screen name/numeric entry, including Save directly from each active input type, Cancel after multi-field changes, omission/value edits, invalid/unfinished input and failed Save/retry. Verify rendered screen, zero packets, saved revision and all definitions/alerts after restart. Retain independent expected results and a reusable action/frame trace for the watch.
- Feed changing valid current-session settings, cached/corrupt/old-session frames, disconnect and reconnect while editing; prove draft/input remains local. Test idle/replay editing without a read requirement and continued replay write prohibition.
- Inject durable-store failures/interruption through the existing adapter, preserve the draft while running, and recover last good saved state after restart. Exercise configuration import/replacement or reload while open, stale/duplicate Save, browser reload/ownership changes and successful close followed by delayed completion.
- Start a riding-preset operation, then save a changed definition through public actions and verify revision invalidation stops unsent writes; preserve explicit partial/unknown outcomes. Cancel/failed Save leaves saved application values intact.
- Replace obsolete fresh-wheel/editor-write expectations for this behavior, run focused application/HTTP/storage/browser checks and typechecking/build, and retain rendering/packet/storage evidence with source provenance. Full gesture parity is completed by the dependent navigation tickets.

## Blocked by

- https://github.com/EvgenyHitexis/EucWatch/issues/44 — provides durable versioned presets with independent remembered dip and inclusion plus legacy recovery.
title: Make laptop preset editing local with whole-editor Save and Cancel
